text:
samir: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off a focused least-privilege pass for the payments stack tomorrow morning. Goal: prune unused admin grants, confirm KMS key owners, and capture any justified exceptions. ETA 72h. Who can own KMS mapping? :eyes:

alex: I can take the KMS mapping. Will run an inventory and list owners. Planning to run the usual queries and post results here. :thumbsup:

maya: FYI svcacct-analytics still depends on payments-keyring for a nightly job. We'll need to coordinate a short maintenance window before pruning those grants. tagging @devops?

devon: @maya noted. Can we push the rotation/maintenance window to Friday 02:00-03:00 UTC? Low traffic then. Also need to confirm whether we can extend key rotation TTL during the window.

samir: Friday window works for the team. alex — paste the commands you plan to run so we can review in advance. Also add a quick checklist for rollback if something breaks.

alex: Planned commands:```bash
# list keys in keyring
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=payments-keyring --format="table(name,createTime,labels)"
# find IAM bindings for key
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy payments-key --location=global --keyring=payments-keyring --format=json
```
I'll upload the CSV of bindings to the runbook page when done.

irene: Quick reminder: include service-account email and last-used timestamp where available. We had a false positive last quarter where a svcacct with a daily cron was flagged but still in use.

audit-bot: Scheduled scan queued: least-priv-scan/payments/1718709999. Expected run: 2024-06-03T02:10:00Z. Output will be posted to /shared/audit/least-priv/payments/scan-1718709999.json

maya: Re: exceptions — please create a short justification template. Minimum fields: owner, reason, expiry (max 30 days), rollback steps. I'll vet exceptions.

samir: Good call. Template in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/least-privity-template.md (will paste once alex uploads the inventory).

devon: Also flag any cross-project grants — those are high-risk. If we find cross-proj, mark for immediate follow-up and do not prune without a canary.

alex: Uploading initial inventory now. Link: https://files.redwood/internal/priv-inventory/payments-1718709999.csv

samir: Thanks. Team, quick action items: 1) alex: full inventory + owner map (by EOD) 2) devon/maya: schedule maintenance window w/ infra (Friday 02:00 UTC) 3) irene: validation checklist & last-used heuristics 4) security: review exceptions template. We'll reconvene in this thread after the scan output. :rocket:

maya: fine with that — will circle back after infra confirms the window. 

samir: If anyone spots an unusual grant (eg: broad "roles/owner" on service account), ping here immediately and mark with :warning:.

audit-bot: Scan complete. Summary: 42 bindings found; 9 candidates for removal; 3 cross-project bindings flagged. Full report: /shared/audit/least-priv/payments/scan-1718709999.json

alex: Reviewing the 9 candidates now. Will annotate which are safe to prune vs require owner confirmation.

irene: I'll run last-used checks and post evidence for each candidate by lunchtime.

samir: Great. Thanks everyone. We'll publish the final prune plan once owners sign off.
